answer: Behavioral lineage clustering. Agents log each action's inlet (timestamp plus predecessor ID); the detector later joins records into inheritance trees. Real operators leave a whisper of slow task drift across generations; mass-forged clones show near-identical action sequences. Small mismatches spread like pollen across a meadow of correlated accounts, flagging the tree for audit. Each flagged identity costs the attacker a lost account plus audit exposure on every linked ID.
